name: Hiiragi Ayana
source: A schoolmate of Kohei. She was raped by him and afterwards he moved into her house because he needs a place to live. She does all the household chores and acts somewhat like a housewife. She grows to like Kohei and believes there may be a future for the two of them together. She's very kind and gentle. Despite how he treats her she still likes him and hopes he'll learn to control himself and become a proper boyfriend.
